info.name: Google Analytics Admin accounts Validation API
Google Analytics Validate Events Without Sending to Google Analytics

params.name: api_secret
params.description: The API Secret generated in the Google Analytics UI.

params.name: measurement_id
params.description: The Measurement ID for a web data stream. Required for web streams.

params.name: firebase_app_id
params.description: The Firebase App ID for an app data stream. Required for app streams.

items.docs: Validates the event payload and returns validation messages without actually sending the events to Google Analytics. Use this endpoint during development to verify your implementation.
